CustomField.description: Free-text name of the person or firm who referred this investor Lead (e.g. "Jane Smith, ABC Wealth Partners"). Deliberately Text, not a Lookup, even though ARCHITECTURE.md rule 3 reserves a bare object-name field for a relationship to that object: the referrer is very often NOT a Salesforce record at all (an external advisor, friend, or unrepresented individual), so a Contact/Lead lookup would fail to capture the common case. Do not "correct" this into a lookup.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter who referred this investor (name and/or firm).
CustomField.label: Referred By
